title: Greater Noida Authority allots plot GH-08
text: Letter No. Builders/2010/1414 allots the 204,000 sq m Group Housing plot GH-08, Sector-01 to a Supertech-led consortium that includes Panchsheel Buildtech, at Rs 10,044 per sq m. Hynish later sits on sub-plot GH-08A.

title: Agreement to lease for sub-plot GH-08A
text: The registered lease deed for GH-08A records an agreement to lease executed on this date.

title: GH-08A lease deed registered to Panchsheel Buildtech
text: Registered at Gautam Budh Nagar as document 17410 of 2010. The approved plan later records the plot as 30,000 sq m (7.41 acres).

title: Land-acquisition crisis in Greater Noida West
text: The Supreme Court upheld quashing of the Shahberi acquisition, and in July the High Court quashed Patwari acquisitions; construction across Noida Extension was disrupted. Hynish is not named in these reports.

title: Builders allowed to resume work
text: After Master Plan 2021 approval the Authority let builders restart; the roughly ten-month halt was treated as a zero period.

title: Revised building plan sanctioned for GH-08A
text: Greater Noida Authority grants a five-year revised sanction. The approved site plan shows T1-T7 as already sanctioned and adds T8-T12.

title: Phase 1 (T8-T9) start date in RERA data
text: Aggregator copies of UP RERA data give 8 August 2014 as the Phase-1 start date (UPRERAPRJ8533). Listings use it as the launch date.

title: Phase 2 (T10-T11) start date in RERA data
text: UPRERAPRJ8538 covers T10 and T11.

title: Deed of Declaration lists 12 towers and 1,312 flats
text: Form A declaration under the UP Apartment Act. It lists the common facilities and says no parking is provided in common areas; the annexures on limited-common and independent areas are not in the circulated copy.

title: Builder press release markets 2 and 3 BHK homes
text: Paid release advertises a base price of Rs 3,724 per sq ft and lists a 60 m front road and 24 m side road.

title: Phase 3 (T12) start date in RERA data
text: UPRERAPRJ8545 covers T12.

title: Phase 1 completion date in RERA data
text: Listings give May 2018 as possession for the project; other listings say January 2021, the Phase-3 date.

title: Tower-10 completion certificate issued
text: Greater Noida Authority certificate for Tower-10 (160 flats), with conditions on parking only in designated areas.

title: About 700 families; 10 towers occupied
text: Hyperlocal reporting says 10 towers were occupied and 2 still under construction.

title: Phase 2 completion date in RERA data
NPCL final notice on multipoint consent
text: Under the 2019-2020 UPERC orders, multipoint was presumed unless the association resolved by majority to keep single point; the society was given 30 days.

title: Phase 3 (T12) completion date in RERA data
text: The last tower. Registry for many Tower-12 owners was still pending in 2026.

title: Registration-year identifier appears on AOA records
text: GBN/10037/2022-2023 appears on association notices and the AOA website. Exact registration day, certificate, memorandum and complete registered bye-laws are not public.

title: Residents register the association
text: The first president said the association was registered on this date and renamed Panchsheel Hynish Flat Owners Association.

title: Initial AOA registration and nine-member board reported
text: News names Diwakar Kumar president, Vishnu Srivastava vice-president, Anuj Kumar secretary, Anand Sharma treasurer; Sourabh Thukral, Ravindra Yadav, Bhaskar Kanungo, Brijendra Singh and Paresh Kumar members. Names transliterated from Hindi; not a verified current roster.

title: Water crisis while builder control was reported
text: Residents and an ad hoc-AOA member described water disruption and builder dues; maintenance disputed key claims. This does not establish the subsequent handover date or liability.

title: 2024 board election recorded in later judgment
text: August 2025 judgment records an admitted election on this date, with a one-year term through 15 March 2025. Primary result sheet and office-bearer transition records are not present. Contemporary reporting: two panels contested under an administration-appointed election officer; one won 7 of 9 seats; Anjali Negi became president.

title: First GBM notice: former-AOA, EC and builder handover
text: Letter PHAOA/24/1/033 called a 7 April meeting. It names Anjali Negi as president. Later records name Vinod Negi; original transition records are required rather than assuming these are interchangeable.

title: GBM scheduled on handover roadmap
text: The notice specified 7 pm at the badminton court. Attendance, resolutions and completion of handover have not been proved by this notice.

title: NPCL reportedly recorded majority multipoint preference
text: Search-result text attributes to NPCL a post on a majority multipoint response and a 20 May 2024 AOA-NPCL meeting before a survey. The post could not be opened; response counts and survey report are unverified.

title: Protest over unopened swimming pool
text: Residents said the pool built years earlier had never been started by the builder.

title: Power-cut protests; NPCL cites damaged transformer
text: NPCL said a transformer inside the society was damaged and a notice had been served on the society.

title: Authority minutes: connection still in builder's name
text: The builder would transfer the electricity connection if the AOA refunded the NPCL security deposit; the AOA agreed and asked for multipoint. A draft handover agreement was being prepared, and handover of the connection and maintenance was directed by 15 July 2024.

title: Managing body registration recorded by court
text: August 2025 judgment records registration of the managing body under Section 4(1). This is distinct from initial AOA registration. Original filed office-bearer list remains missing.

title: Pump-room confrontation described in later reporting
text: Reported assault complaint following unequal-water-supply concerns. No finding of guilt, FIR disposition or original complaint was verified.

title: AOA delegation meets MP over water shortage
text: AOA office-bearers and residents met MP Dr Mahesh Sharma, who reportedly spoke to officials and the builder.

title: Police reconciliation / WhatsApp warning reported
text: News describes a meeting of the parties and a police warning over inflammatory messages. Exact police record is absent.

title: Special meeting notice: CAM handover, MOU, action plan
text: Letter PHAOA/24/1/078 describes ongoing builder/GNIDA discussions and calls a 21 July meeting. It is not the signed MOU.

title: CAM-handover special meeting scheduled
text: Agenda included issues with builder, MOU discussion and resolution on the further handover plan. Meeting minutes and votes are missing.

title: Authority minutes: builder-AOA MOU "in progress"
text: Minutes of the 16 July meeting: the builder's MD said MOU signing was in progress; the AOA said annexure points were unresolved. The AOA then asked for a handover order before 1 August.

title: Gate-access dispute reported with society-name inconsistency
text: An article titled Hynish uses Panchsheel Heights in its body; treated as an attribution lead rather than a firmly matched Hynish incident.

title: AOA takes over maintenance from the builder
text: AOA minutes and its annual "Hynish Day" give 7 September 2024; one news report said 6 September. The electricity connection was not part of it: NPCL still billed the builder in 2026. The handover agreement and inventory are not in hand.

title: Lift drop reported in Tower 3
text: Residents said a lift fell from the 3rd floor to the ground; no injury reported.

title: GBM notice connects MOU compliance and NPCL multipoint
text: Calls 22 December GBM. It shows the multipoint and MOU-compliance agenda existed well before the October 2026 dispute.

title: GBM on MOU, infrastructure and NPCL scheduled
text: Actual minutes, MOU terms and follow-up decisions remain missing.

title: Residents' memorandum seeks 2025-26 election
text: Two AOA members delivered a memorandum asking for an election committee and GBM.

title: Hynish water-quality notice reported
text: News distinguishes Hynish notices from the Rs 5 lakh fine on Ecovillage-1. No Hynish fine is established by that headline.

title: Deputy Registrar: hold the election by the Act and bye-laws
text: Letter 3194 forwards a residents' complaint about voting rights and the unamended Deed of Declaration and warns that an election against the rules would be void.

title: General body process for next election recorded
text: Judgment recounts a process initially proposing elections for 9 March. Later administrative intervention changed the sequence.

title: Deputy Registrar cancels February GBM and committee (reported)
text: After hearing both sides, the DR reportedly declared the 16 February committee invalid. The High Court judgment separately records a 7 March DR direction.

title: Deputy Registrar directed fresh proceedings
text: Recounted in August judgment; original order absent.

title: Fresh notice for general body meeting
text: Issued following the 7 March direction, according to the judgment.

title: First meeting lacked quorum
text: Court recounts adjournment/fresh notice and a later meeting. Original attendance register not obtained.

title: Election committee constituted
text: Constitution of the committee and subsequent procedure became disputed. Allegations of procedural breaches are not automatically findings of fraud.

title: Election schedule declared
text: Election fixed for 22 March in the court-recounted chronology.

title: Disputed election held
text: Vinod Negi is identified as elected president in the August decision. Validity and handling of objections led to successive administrative and judicial proceedings.

title: Deputy Registrar discarded election, invoked Section 25(2)
text: Original order not obtained; its existence and treatment are recorded in the High Court judgment. The official judgment PDF reproduces the order: it named the District Backward Class Welfare Officer as election officer.

title: AOA reported time-expired; District Supply Officer as election officer
text: Report says the Deputy Registrar declared the AOA time-expired after the 15 March 2025 term end and named the District Supply Officer election officer; residents wrote to the DM. Order date and reference not given. The High Court quashed the 15 May 2025 DR order on 1 August 2025.

title: Election officer asks AOA for records and election cost
text: The District Supply Officer, nominated election officer on 20 June 2025, asked for the declaration, voter list, bye-laws and Rs 2.56 lakh by 5 July for an election within a month.

title: High Court quashed DR order and remanded
text: Writ-C 17915/2025 with 19634/2025 allowed; dispute returned to Prescribed Authority for fresh hearing, preferably within eight weeks from receipt of certified copy. This was not a final merits declaration validating every election step.

title: Basement-market flooding reported
text: Trader losses and maintenance concerns reported; engineering cause and legal liability not independently established.

title: Public complaint alleged duplicate maintenance billing
text: Forum post claims prepaid deductions alongside separate invoices. It is not a consumer commission order.

title: AOA notice for 24 August 2025 GBM
text: The AOA website listed notices for meetings on 12 March, 11 May, 13 July and 24 August 2025. Minutes are not public.

title: Deputy Registrar refers election dispute to SDM Dadri
text: DR letter 6021, recalled in the order of 31 December 2025, sent the dispute to the Prescribed Authority under Section 25(1) after the High Court remand.

title: Summoning order in builder cheque complaint
text: HC 8843/2026 later identifies an ACJM Ghaziabad summons in Complaint 380/2025. Complaint, cheque, amount, signatory record and eventual outcome are absent.

title: Certified-copy presentation / status quo in May narrative
text: May judgment paragraph 4 originally printed 19 October; correction order changes it to 9 October. Paragraph 5 also refers to a 9 October status-quo order. Underlying file/service records remain necessary.

title: Deputy Registrar order on meetings while the reference is pending
text: Order 3169: while the SDM reference is pending, AGBMs not held according to the rules would be void. It does not declare particular meetings void.

title: Restriction on policy / major financial decisions recounted
text: May paragraph 5 originally printed 27 February; 20 May correction changes this to 7 February. Scope, service and subsequent variation of original restraint are not independently established.

title: Residents seek DM inquiry into AOA decisions
text: Report says the executive lacked Deputy Registrar recognition while the matter was before SDM Dadri; residents alleged renovation collections and arbitrary GBMs. AOA called the allegations baseless. No amounts or orders given.

title: Status-quo / no-policy-decision order mentioned
text: April SDM extract reproduced in the May judgment mentions a 19 February order and an election-committee meeting. Alleged non-compliance was disputed; full administrative records are missing.

title: GSTAT anti-profiteering order covers Hynish Tower-10
text: Reported order in NAPA/59/PB/2025 computes Rs 29,68,382 for 161 Tower-10 buyers within a Rs 98.7 lakh total across three projects, with interest and a conditional 10% penalty. Separate from AOA, parking and election matters; compliance unverified.

title: Fresh elections notified
text: May paragraph 14 records this and the ensuing restraint. Notification itself is absent.

title: Election restraint recorded; proposed March poll stopped
text: May paragraph 14 identifies a 23 February order. Contemporary news describes a proposed 1 March election and resident objections.

title: Term expiry submitted to court
text: Petitioners argued expiry of the March 2025 committee term; the Court also considered Clause 26(iii) holdover pending successors. Term expiry alone does not describe the full legal position.

title: NPCL multipoint conversion across Greater Noida
text: NPCL reports 91 societies on individual connections and notices to 130+; UPERC order requires conversion.

title: High Court disposes of Tower-11/12 sub-lease writ
text: Writ-C 13589/2026 (Sourabh Thukral and 28 others) was disposed of without any view on the merits: the Authority was to decide the home-buyers' 12 February 2026 representation, preferably within three months of the certified copy. Early reports of a 90-day registry order overstated it. Text as quoted in the Authority's 15 July order; the signed High Court order is not in hand.

title: HC order on compromise route in cheque case
text: BNSS 8843/2026 disposed with conditional compromise procedure and limited no-coercive-measures period. It is separate from election litigation and does not establish final settlement.

title: SDM set aside March 2025 election
text: Operative SDM text is reproduced in May judgment. HC later rejected the reasoning; original complete SDM decision is missing.

title: Deputy Registrar consequential order
text: The May 2026 judgment discusses a Deputy Registrar action under Section 25(2) dated 29 April 2026, following the 24 April SDM order. The order itself is not public.

title: Writ-C 18764/2026 filed
text: Filing CIVIL12/112933/2026; diary 10863052026; registered 8 May. Parties include AOA and Vinod Negi against State, DR, Prescribed Authority/SDM and Anuj Kumar.

title: Registry still pending for about 300 families
text: A month after the April order, residents said neither the Authority nor the builder had started registry for two towers.

title: HC remanded reference question; set two-stage timetable
text: Order sets aside 24 April decision; considers why 25(2) rationale is inappropriate after restrained elections; directs reference-maintainability decision within one month of certified-copy production, then elections within one month of that decision. Read entire order.

title: Correction application filed
text: IA/2/2026 filed; disposal on 20 May is recorded in case history.

title: Three date corrections ordered
text: Paragraph 4: 19.10.2025 becomes 09.10.2025. Paragraph 5: 27.02.2026 becomes 07.02.2026. Paragraph 12: 22.03.2026 becomes 22.03.2025. Other apparent textual anomalies are not silently corrected.

title: Environmental recovery reporting: scope unresolved
text: Hynish listed in multi-society STP enforcement report; no Hynish-specific amount or AOA-versus-builder liability allocation verified.

title: Authority orders builder to complete T11/T12 sub-leases
text: Following the High Court direction, the Authority ordered the builder to deposit Rs 92,97,055 lease rent and, within three months, obtain completion for Towers 11 and 12 and execute sub-leases for their home-buyers. It recorded that completion had not been obtained.

title: Metro link to Greater Noida West approved by PIB
text: Proposed 8.4 km line to Gaur Chowk awaits Cabinet approval.

title: NPCL notice: collection reports and CA audit in 15 days
text: Addressed to the builder and the AOA under the 10 October 2024 tariff order; penalties for defaults, otherwise conversion to multipoint at "you / residents'" cost.

title: SDM reportedly dismissed election challenge
text: 6 October news reports insufficient one-quarter support. Obtain the signed decision before asserting its exact directions, signature findings or present effect.

title: Election-officer directions reportedly issued
text: 17 October report says required AOA records were due by 19 October. Original directions, election programme and compliance record remain missing.

title: NPCL visit halted after resident opposition
text: NPCL's account: about 200 residents opposed the conversion and asked for a fresh survey; police advised a halt. The notice does not attribute the opposition to the AOA.

title: NPCL final notice to builder and AOA
text: Notice 156 to the builder's MD and the AOA President and Secretary: access within 24 hours, a nominated representative, the team to return on 28 October, re-survey refused, disconnection warned. Its basis is "three defaults" under the tariff order, not owner consent.

title: Green-belt counters and fire-lane parking dispute
text: Residents objected to counters in the market green belt and parking in the 6 m fire lane; they sought a joint inspection.

title: NPCL installation reportedly did not proceed
text: Residents alleged opposition from AOA/supporters and team departure. This is not an independently verified finding of obstruction or motive. No record of what happened that day is in hand; NPCL's notice documents opposition at the 15 October visit.

title: Current Writ-C 45508/2026 filed
text: CIVIL12/276142/2026, diary 266021102026. Full petition/prayer pages have not been obtained.

title: Resident reports failed prepaid meter and disconnection threat
text: A resident says his prepaid meter failed within months, he was asked to buy a new one instead of a warranty replacement, and was threatened with disconnection; police attended. No AOA or NPCL response reported. A meter fault and the authority to disconnect are separate questions.

title: Current writ registered, pending; no order displayed
text: Writ-C 45508/2026; CNR UPHC056633602026. Stage Newly Fresh, no hearing dates displayed; Order/Judgement Not Found at capture. Portal silence is not a certified finding that no order exists anywhere.
